documents.content: Refund policy: customers may request a refund within thirty calendar days of purchase. A receipt is required.
Deployment guide: production releases require a passing test suite and an approved change record before rollout. Release owners must record the deployment outcome after the rollout.
Security policy: API credentials must be stored in the managed secret vault and must never be committed to source control.
Support schedule: the service desk operates Monday through Friday from 09:00 to 17:00 UTC.
Release planning includes a weekly schedule, service desk coordination, and a change record review. This document does not define the production release gate.
